newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB sells 300,000 T wheat to Algeria - trade.
newsitem.headline: CWB sells 300,000 T wheat to Algeria - trade.

text.p: Canadian Wheat Board sold 150,000 tonnes of milling wheat and 150,000 tonnes of durum wheat to Algeria, trade sources said.
"They sold the durum at US$200 CIF Algeria for July-August delivery and they sold 150,000 of milling wheat for July, August, September shipments at US$159 CIF which is pretty low," one source said.
The CWB would neither confirm nor deny the trade talk.
The last time the CWB sold that much milling wheat to Algeria was in crop year 1987/88 (Aug/July) when it sold 153,000 tonnes, the CWB's 1995/96 annual report shows.
"The Board changed its durum program last week. You could get durum for July and now you can only get some for August so it must have all gone to the Algerians," another source said.
Algeria issued an optional-origin durum wheat tender, European sources said.
